<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="תמוז_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518919434_theRebbe_712" batchId="meluket-_D7_AA_D7_9E_D7_95_D7_96_meluket__BH_POST_1766518919434_theRebbe_712__p005">
  <section v="12">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Yaakov corresponds to the head tefillin and Yosef to the hand tefillin, connecting Ein Sof with the emanated beings and with the created beings respectively.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">6)</t>
    <t s="1">And he continues in the maamar,</t>
    <t s="2">that this is what is said in the Shelah,</t>
    <t s="3">that Yaakov is the head tefillin and Yosef is the hand tefillin,</t>
    <t s="4">for through the head tefillin the connection is made</t>
    <t s="5">(tefillin from the term connection)</t>
    <t s="6">of Ein Sof the Emanator with the emanated beings,</t>
    <t s="7">which draws additional light into Abba and Imma and Zeir Anpin of Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="8">and through the hand tefillin, which is in Malchus</t>
    <t s="9">[as it is said,</t>
    <t s="10">"And you shall bind them as a sign upon your hand,"</t>
    <t s="11">the weak hand,</t>
    <t s="12">the weak hand is Malchus]</t>
    <t s="13">the connection of Ein Sof is made</t>
    <t s="14">(also)</t>
    <t s="15">with the created beings.</t>
    <t s="16">[For this is why the head tefillin is called Pe'er,</t>
    <t s="17">like an ornament with which a person adorns himself,</t>
    <t s="18">and the hand tefillin</t>
    <t s="19">is only a garment,</t>
    <t s="20">for Biyah are garments and the Sefiros of Atzilus are called Tikkunin,</t>
    <t s="21">for Tikkunin is like ornaments].</t>
    <t s="22">And this is that Yaakov is the head tefillin and Yosef the hand tefillin,</t>
    <t s="23">for Yaakov is the central bolt that connects and joins Ein Sof with the emanated beings,</t>
    <t s="24">and Yosef connects</t>
    <t s="25">[Yosef is a fruitful son,</t>
    <t s="26">Pores is the letters of Tofer,</t>
    <t s="27">sews and connects]</t>
    <t s="28">Ein Sof with the created beings.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="13">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Although the flow to Biyah requires prior flow in Atzilus, the hand tefillin is placed before the head tefillin because the elevation from Israel's service is primarily in the lower unity of Biyah.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And it needs to be understood,</t>
    <t s="1">since in order for there to be an influence into Biyah there must first be the influence in Atzilus,</t>
    <t s="2">why do we precede the laying of the hand tefillin to the head tefillin?</t>
    <t s="3">And the explanation can be given based on what is known,</t>
    <t s="4">that the mitzvos of the Holy One, blessed be He, which are done through Israel fulfilling the mitzvos, are more elevated than the mitzvos of the Holy One, blessed be He, as they are in themselves.</t>
    <t s="5">And one may add,</t>
    <t s="6">that in the mitzvah of tefillin,</t>
    <t s="7">this matter is even more so.</t>
    <t s="8">For since in the tefillin of the Master</t>
    <t s="9">of the world, what is written in them? "And who</t>
    <t s="10">is like Your people Israel, one nation in the land,"</t>
    <t s="11">for the Holy One, blessed be He, praises Himself with the praise of Israel,</t>
    <t s="12">— therefore, the service of Israel,</t>
    <t s="13">the laying of the tefillin of Israel, touches upon this even more.</t>
    <t s="14">And therefore we precede the laying of the hand tefillin to the head tefillin,</t>
    <t s="15">for the superiority of service is primarily in the service of the lower unity</t>
    <t s="16">(Biyah),</t>
    <t s="17">and therefore the service of the lower unity reaches higher than the service of the upper unity</t>
    <t s="18">(Atzilus),</t>
    <t s="19">and the addition that is made in the tefillin of the Master of the world</t>
    <t s="20">[the drawing of Ein Sof in Atzilus</t>
    <t s="21">(head tefillin)</t>
    <t s="22">and in Biyah</t>
    <t s="23">(hand tefillin)]</t>
    <t s="24">through the laying of the tefillin of Israel,</t>
    <t s="25">is primarily through the laying of the hand tefillin.</t>
  </section>
  <section v="14">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>Because Israel arose in the Essential Thought above all revelation, their service adds elevation to God's mitzvos, and the drawing into Biyah reaches the very Essence above the source of influence.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">And behold, that through the fulfillment of the mitzvos of Israel an elevation is added in the mitzvos of the Holy One, blessed be He, is</t>
    <t s="1">because Israel arose in thought,</t>
    <t s="2">the Essential Thought that is above all revelations</t>
    <t s="3">(even above the revelation of the "Delighter in Kindness"</t>
    <t s="4">which is the root and cause of all revelations),</t>
    <t s="5">and therefore through the service</t>
    <t s="6">(fulfillment of the mitzvos)</t>
    <t s="7">of Israel, an elevation is added in the mitzvos of the Holy One, blessed be He.</t>
    <t s="8">And based on this, one may give another reason for this, that the addition in the tefillin of the Master of the world is primarily through the laying of the hand tefillin,</t>
    <t s="9">for the drawing into Biyah</t>
    <t s="10">(hand tefillin)</t>
    <t s="11">reaches the very Essence that is above the root of influence and revelation</t>
    <t s="12">(as above in section 5),</t>
    <t s="13">which in general terms is the aspect of the aforementioned Essential Thought.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
